reason: 该插件的主要面向用户用途是将 OpenAI Codex（基于 ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth）作为模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持在模型选择与对话流程中使用 Codex、查询状态与配额并处理相关工具能力；基于证据其核心价值是外部 LLM 服务接入与运行时适配，故归类为 external-services。

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，可接入 OpenAI Codex（ChatGPT Plus/Pro）并通过模型选择与 `/codex` 命令在会话中使用该模型。
summaries.en: This plugin connects DeepSeek Harness to OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) so users can use Codex models through the model selector and `/codex` workflow in chat.

capabilities: Integrates OpenAI Codex as a DeepSeek Harness LLM provider via `openai-codex`.
Implements `/codex` command operations for login, device login, logout, status, and usage queries.
Bridges Codex Responses streaming, tool-calling, and image input to Harness stream/chunk handling.
Adds native hosted `web_search` request transformation when enabled by turn options.
Stores and refreshes OAuth credentials through DSH credential service and surfaces usage data from external endpoints.

reasons.code: README describes `openai-codex` provider route and Codex model availability in DSH model selector.
README documents `/codex` login/device login/logout/status/usage command flow and OAuth token use.
README states native web_search conversion and image/tool handling are part of request/response adaptation.
package.json defines DSH plugin bundle/client entry points and network/LLM dependencies for external service integration.
Repository tree lists adapter, web-search, credentials, usage, and client modules consistent with provider/runtime integration.
